About Acme Robotics

Acme Robotics was founded in 2016 by Jane Okoro and Marcus Lindqvist in Austin, Texas. The company builds autonomous warehouse robots used by mid-size logistics operators across North America.

As of its most recent funding round in 2023, Acme Robotics has raised a total of 48 million dollars across three rounds and employs roughly 210 people. The company's flagship product, the Acme Sorter-9, is deployed in over 60 warehouses.

In 2021, Acme Robotics settled a patent dispute with a competitor over its gripper-arm design; no other public controversies have been reported since.
